title: Thompson’s Cozy home
description:
Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

The space
My home is located  on the corner leading into a cul-de-sac in a quite residential area of Inglewood.  It’s a three bedroom, two bath single family home. The master has a queen size bed, bedroom # 2 has 2 queen over queen bunk beds, bedroom #3 has a full size bed.

Guest access
The front door is available for entering the home. A keypad code will be provided.

Other things to note
We are 3.6miles from Titan Stadium, 3.9 miles from First Horizon Park, 4.3 miles from Broadway, 1.9 miles from The Grand old Opera, 4.3 miles from the Ryman Auditorium and Bridgestone Arena, 4.1 miles from the Ascend Amphitheater, 8.5 miles from Nashville Soccer Club and 4.2 miles from the Schrmerhorn Symphony .
